verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is payments and commerce infrastructure that lets AI agents check out, tokenize credentials and sync product feeds, so a user-configured background automation feature is a fair question for it. However, the evidence documents no capability for users to define automations, recurring schedules or autonomous background jobs. Webhooks, automatic feed adaptation and Adyen-handled checkout orchestration are adjacent building blocks or built-in behaviors, not user-set-up automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
